contentList.content: Old Beggar
The Forgotten One
No Master to Serve
An unremarkable old man. He smells foul and grumbles without end. Listen closely, and you will notice how often he asks to be killed.
Tesshin
Blade of House Hozana
A Blade Without a Sheath

House Hozana was honest and valorous and cared for the sick and the destitute, or so it is remembered. Until the man-eaters of the Bazaki clan carried out their infamous raid and cut down the whole family line. Only Tesshin, a samurai in the service of the house, managed to drink from the forbidden dragon spring in time, and he avenged the Bazaki bloodshed. The immortality he gained came at a price, drawing all sorts of planar creatures to him, the Dark One among them, who struck a "valorous" bargain with him and promised a swift death. Which, naturally, never came.
Corpse-Eater
Gift of the Forbidden Spring
The Road Back
Tesshin lies where he fell. The crab is outside only while he lies there. Kill it before he rises, and both of them die.
Borrowed Valour
Allies within [1] gain [2] to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.
Elder’s Guard
Allies within [1] gain [2] Armour Class.
The Stench of a Long Life
Enemies within [1] must succeed a Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned.
Blood Tide
While Tesshin is Bleeding, enemies within [1] must succeed a Constitution Saving Throw or be Poisoned.
The Spring Does Not Let Go
Tesshin regains [1] hit points at the start of each of his turns. Nothing interrupts it, not even Downed.
Patching the Shell
Tesshin regains [1] hit points each time an attack or a spell wounds him.
Pain as Offering
A Critical Hit against Tesshin grants him [1] Temporary Hit Points.
Shallow Cut
No killing blow can finish Tesshin. He falls instead, and while he lies there, the crab inside him crawls out. Kill the crab before he rises, and both of them die.
Nose for Poison
The wielder attacks <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="POISONED">Poisoned</LSTag> targets with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.
Twin Slash
Tesshin strikes with both blades as a single <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ActionPoint">Action</LSTag>, without the usual penalty to his <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>.
Courtesy Demands an Answer
When an enemy with more than half their <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag> strikes Tesshin, he closes on them and answers with four cuts.
Kusarigama
When an enemy strikes Tesshin from range or with a spell, he throws a hooked chain, drags them to him and deals [1]. A failed Dexterity Saving Throw leaves them Prone.
Kaishaku
Tesshin’s main blade, which served him faithfully for four hundred years. It has soaked up the magic of the dragon spring.
The Lesser Mercy
The short blade stays at his side even indoors. It was meant for his own hand, and that hour never came.
A hit additionally deals [1]. The target must succeed a Constitution Saving Throw or be Paralysed.
A hit additionally deals [1]. The target must succeed a Constitution Saving Throw or fall asleep. Any damage wakes the sleeper.
Black Lacquer

A Paralysed creature cannot move or act. It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws, Attack Rolls against it have Advantage, and a hit from within [1] is a Critical Hit.

A Constitution Saving Throw at the end of each turn ends the effect.
Mercy

A sleeping creature cannot move or act. It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws, Attack Rolls against it have Advantage, and a hit from within [1] is a Critical Hit.

Removed by any damage or when a companion Helps the creature.
Oh, how much longer! Kill me, take pity on an old man!
If you do not kill me now, you will be cursed for the rest of your life!
Oof, sorry! No, not sorry!
Cruel... But merciful.
I am in my own body again... Strike me down, with honour.
Dark One, I will still have my revenge on you!
Strike exactly as the warrior code says - without fear.
That was a child’s blow. Look for your mistakes.
Let us see how you take a blow.
I expect nothing but an honest fight from you. Anything else is a disgrace.
These blades cut flesh like butter.
Do not run away. We have a long fight ahead of us!
A good strike. But a weak one.
The spring still holds me...
KACHI. KACHI. KACHI.
kasa kasa kasa kasa kasa
...chi.
